title: BANXE CostCap (AI Cost Governance)
description: Executable contract for the AI cost-governance CostCap configuration (ADR-047 AI Cost Governance Policy). Validates the HARD caps on two axes — per-request and per-time-window — each expressed in BOTH a token dimension and a monetary (cost) dimension, so neither a cheap-but-infinite loop nor one expensive call escapes (ADR-047 D2). Caps are HARD: a breach blocks/halts, it does not merely warn (CLAUDE.md §11). Config-over-hardcoding (CLAUDE.md §10): the VALUES live in repo config as data validated by this schema, never in code or in the ADR. The unit of cost governance is the agent passport (ADR-047 D1) — `per_agent_budget` maps each agent_id to its CostCap; budget magnitude scales with the passport risk_ceiling. All monetary values are DECIMAL STRINGS, never floats (CLAUDE.md money rule). R-SEC: this is a config artefact — it MUST NOT carry secrets, API keys, or LiteLLM credentials; the gateway key/route material lives in the LiteLLM config, not here.

decimalString.description: Monetary amount as a decimal string — never a float (CLAUDE.md money rule).

max_request_tokens.description: ADR-047 D2 per-request cap (token dimension). Max tokens (in+out) for a single agent invocation/decision. A request that would exceed this is REFUSED at the LiteLLM gateway before completion. Bounds the blast radius of one runaway call.

max_request_cost.description: ADR-047 D2 per-request cap (monetary dimension), decimal string. Max cost of a single inference request; exceeding it is refused at the gateway.

max_window_tokens.description: ADR-047 D2 per-window cap (token dimension). Max tokens for one agent over a rolling time window. Breach trips the circuit-breaker (ADR-047 D3) and escalation (D4).

max_window_cost.description: ADR-047 D2 per-window cap (monetary dimension), decimal string. The agent's monetary budget over the window; breach trips the circuit-breaker and HITL escalation.

window.description: OPTIONAL rolling window length as config-as-data (e.g. 1m, 1h, 1d) over which max_window_* applies (ADR-047 D2 — windows are config-as-data). Omitted = the deployment default window.

currency.description: OPTIONAL ISO-4217 currency of the *_cost decimal strings (e.g. GBP, USD). Omitted = the config-as-data reporting-currency default (ADR-047 cost_currency).

soft_band_fraction.description: OPTIONAL fraction of a window cap at which budget_breach_flag=WARN is raised before the hard BREACH (ADR-047 D5 WARN band). E.g. 0.8 = warn at 80% of the window budget.

caps.description: Default/global CostCap applied when an agent has no per-agent override. ADR-047 D2 hard caps on both axes.

per_agent_budget.description: ADR-047 D1 — the agent passport is the unit of cost governance. Maps each agent_id (snake_case, same id space as agent_passport.schema.json / .claude/rules/agents.md roster) to its CostCap. An agent with no budget here AND no `caps` default is, for governance purposes, ungoverned and MUST NOT be promoted past dev (ADR-047 D1 / CLAUDE.md §11).
